skill.summary: Autonomous Binance spot trading bot with LLM-powered market analysis. Supports momentum trading, mean reversion, and DCA strategies on any Binance spot pair. Use when user wants to trade on Binance, set up automated crypto trading, build a spot trading bot, or automate DCA buying. Features technical analysis, LLM sentiment evaluation, position sizing, and portfolio tracking.

latestVersion.changelog: Initial release: autonomous Binance spot trading with momentum, mean reversion, and DCA strategies plus LLM sentiment analysis
